summary: Neural-network-driven game bots with human constraints: a Bot Agent component that perceives, decides (MLP inference from AIBackbone-trained weights, or a built-in heuristic) and acts through the same movement/aim/shoot channels as a human player, with reaction latency, aim error, turn-rate and fire-rate limits.
requirements: Bots move through the PhysX character controller (enable PhysX5). Train policies with the AIBackbone gem's AI Model Builder and assign the exported .weights.json.
